biography.value:
Fawful's Forces packet sheet — Furybean Brute. Built by tools/build-forge-packets.py from the NPC Forge roster data/forge/fawfuls-forces.json (entry furybean-brute): Medium humanoid (Beanish, vat-warped), Chaotic Evil; CR 3 (proficiency +2, to hit +6 with STR); AC 13 (thick vat hide), hit points 60 (8d8+24), speed 30 ft.. A GM scene kit for the Fawful's Forces article's present (1040 BF), not a filed event; the faction article stays the authority.

"Mutate" is the faction article's word; the garrison's is "the vats". A Furybean started as a trooper who volunteered, or did not, for a week in the green tanks under the kitchens, and came out twice the size with a vocabulary of one word. They are kept behind the Fury-Bots until something needs lifting, throwing or breaking, and then they are let go.

The regeneration is the fight: five a turn, forever, unless the party brings cold. Anything frosty — a spell, a wand, a bucket of the castle's own ice-house — shuts it off for a round and the brute is suddenly a big slow bag of hit points. Expect it to grab a small party member and throw them at a large one.

Role: mutated brute · tier: vat-work · folder: Fawful's Furious Freaks / The Bean Garrison.

Art

Token plate portraits/fawfuls-forces/furybean-brute.png — NPC Forge render, seed 410009, cut from a flat #FF00FF field. Prompt: Clean cel-shaded cartoon character art in the style of Mario & Luigi RPG concept art, bold dark outlines, flat colours, simple shading. A huge hulking lime-green bean-shaped brute with bulging muscles, green vein patterns, an enormous furious open mouth full of teeth, tiny angry eyes, wearing torn mustard-yellow overalls with brass buckles and brown boots, fists clenched. Full body, whole figure visible, three-quarter view, centred, isolated on a plain flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no border.

description.value: The Furybean Brute makes two attacks: two Slams, or one Slam and one Grab.
Melee Weapon Attack: reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 4 bludgeoning damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 1d6 + 4 bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The brute can hold two creatures this way.

The brute throws a creature it is grappling up to 20 feet in a straight line. The thrown creature lands prone and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage; if it lands on another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and fall prone too.
The brute regains 5 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point and has taken no cold damage since the end of its last turn. The vat growth hates the cold.
The brute counts as Large for the purpose of grappling and of being grappled, pushed or knocked prone, and can grapple two creatures at once, one in each hand.
The first time the brute is reduced to half its hit points or fewer, it can use its reaction to make one Slam attack against each creature within 5 feet of it.
